LESSON: FUEL CONSERVATION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.3: Fuel Conservation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Fuel Conservation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does reducing fuel wastage conserve our resources?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of fuels used at home

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify types of fuels used at home
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of fuels used at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Fuel Conservation using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Fuel Conservation in the examples.
2. Explain Fuel Conservation to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Fuel Conservation.
4. Show that you can: identify types of fuels used at home

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fuel Conservation using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Fuel Conservation important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss to enumerate the types of fuels such as charcoal, firewood, gas and kerosene used at home,
2. Practise ways of conserving fuels such as putting off fire when done and using fuel efficient equipment when cooking,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of fuels used at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
